items.description: Docs by LangChain covers LangSmith, Fleet, and LangChain's open source packages (LangChain, LangGraph, Deep Agents), organized around an agent development lifecycle: Build, Test, Deploy, Monitor
Agent development lifecycle documentation area (about 1540 pages): Home, Build, Test, Deploy, Monitor
Build docs, Python: building agents with the open source packages Deep Agents, Managed Deep Agents, LangChain, LangGraph and OpenWiki, plus integrations, learning material, reference and contributing
Build docs, TypeScript/JavaScript: Deep Agents, Managed Deep Agents, LangChain, LangGraph, plus integrations, learning material, reference and contributing
Deploy docs: shipping agents to production, covering deployment components, develop and test, frameworks and platforms, and reference
Monitor docs: tracing, debugging and observing agents with LangSmith

LangSmith REST API reference: one page per API operation, grouped as tracing, datasets, evaluation, feedback, prompts, administration (workspaces, orgs, SSO, API keys, usage limits), sandboxes, LLM Gateway, threads and more
Products and setup docs: LangSmith setup, LLM Gateway, Tool Gateway, no-code agents, Engine, Deep Agents Code
LangSmith setup docs: hosting and administration
Hosted API OpenAPI spec at api.host.langchain.com
The documentation is indexed through nested /_llms/ index files, which must be followed recursively to reach the actual documentation pages
